opening.argument: The video presents an ordinary retail-reselling activity built around products, catalogs, orders, and social-media selling. It identifies the featured service as “a reselling App,” then describes browsing products for personal or household use, searching the catalog, and placing orders. The sales process is likewise tied to established platforms: products can be sold through WhatsApp, Facebook, and Instagram. Although the presentation includes earning claims and a team-commission feature, those features accompany product resale rather than establishing a deceptive payment, credential, or investment-return scheme. The supplied material therefore supports a commerce-based reselling service, while leaving the promotional earnings and referral features as stated limitations rather than proof of a different underlying activity.
